e01-l01-draconia.delivery: [urgent], low but carrying, mid-run breath; "only at me" is pleading under the order
e01-l01-draconia.line: Potter, don't turn around! Look at me - only at me - and walk over here slowly.

e01-l02-draconia.delivery: [rushed], breathless, half a laugh in the last clause
e01-l02-draconia.line: Dance with me right now. The floor won't touch us while we're moving - you can scream at me when we're alive.

e01-l03-harry.delivery: level, dry, unhurried against the chaos
e01-l03-harry.line: Fine, I'm dancing. Now tell me what those things are and why they're aiming at me.

e01-l04-draconia.line: It's a long story, and it ends with you alive. Watch the ceiling, Potter, not me.

e01-l05-harry.line: The arrows land on the orchestra's offbeat. Change your step with me - half a beat late, on my count.

e01-l06-draconia.line: You actually counted. Good. Then count faster, because the music isn't slowing down for us.

e01-l07-draconia.line: Show-off. Even you can't cut all three.

e01-l08-harry.line: Efficient. Remind me to applaud once the orchestra gives me my hand back.

e01-l09-draconia.line: I absolutely meant to do that. The trolley was always part of my plan.

e01-l10-harry.line: You really didn't. But I'll take the catch - thank you.

e01-l11-draconia.line: He's using the waltz grid. Every proper step we dance together seals another door.

e01-l12-harry.line: Then we stop dancing properly. Break the grid with me - wrong steps, on purpose.

e01-l13-draconia.line: That was your plan? Bring the entire ceiling down on the hall?

e01-l14-harry.line: Left side, three beats, the red table. Flip it on my mark and hold it over us.

e01-l15-draconia.line: Harry... it has our names. Both of them, burned right in.

e01-l16-harry.line: Draconia. Look at me. What did you do?

e01-l17-draconia.emotion: fear and old frustration, openly, for the first time
e01-l17-draconia.line: I tried to warn you for weeks. You never once listened.

e02-l01-harry.emotion: cornered anger over fear; low, slow, each word placed
e02-l01-harry.line: Warn me about what, Draconia? Say it plainly this time.

e02-l02-draconia.line: Not here. I will not say it while this room is still listening to us.

e02-l03-curse.emotion: emotionless, patient, wrong. Slow count, off the actual waltz tempo. Narrator-class voice

e02-l04-harry.line: Tell me those things are only reflections. Tell me they are not us.

e02-l05-draconia.line: They're what this trial expects us to become. Don't you dare bow back.

e02-l06-harry.line: It copied my footing, but it can't copy my temper. Watch.

e02-l07-draconia.line: It dances better than me. Lucky for us, I cheat better than it.

e02-l08-harry.line: It's not attacking us anymore. It's casting us, like actors in its rehearsal.

e02-l09-draconia.line: This is the founding trial - my family's trial, Potter. It only releases the pair that finishes the waltz together.

e02-l10-harry.line: Then we finish it together. And afterward, you tell me everything.

e02-l11-draconia.line: Every right step feeds it, and every wrong one punishes us. It's not a dance, Potter - it's a lesson.

e02-l12-draconia.line: Every wrong step takes a piece of you and keeps it. Stop testing it, Harry.

e02-l13-draconia.line: There is a forfeit step. A Malfoy can end this trial by yielding the pair-bond. I just didn't want to pay that price.

e02-l14-harry.line: Don't you dare pay that price alone. Not for me.

e02-l15-curse.emotion: pleased, patient. Emphasis: "honesty". Cut to black on the last word

e03-l01-draconia.line: Whatever you think you found down here, we are leaving right now.

e03-l02-harry.line: This is your family's handwriting, Draconia, written before the ball. Start talking.

e03-l03-draconia.emotion: [rushed], deflection with real fear under it
e03-l03-draconia.line: Fly first. You can hate me properly once we're at altitude.

e03-l04-harry.emotion: alarmed realization, [urgent], louder than his norm against wind
e03-l04-harry.line: It's the same count as the ballroom! The storm is following the waltz!

e03-l05-draconia.line: Then stop flying on the beat! Break your rhythm, now!

e03-l06-harry.emotion: [nervous] humor over real fear, strained mid-fall
e03-l06-harry.line: A little help would be lovely right about now!

e03-l07-draconia.line: I've got you. Hold on to me - I've got you.

e03-l08-harry.line: You knew. Before the ball ever started, you knew some part of this.

e03-l09-draconia.emotion: confession at speed, voice breaking on "mark you"
e03-l09-draconia.line: The warning spell was mine. I knew the trial wakes for a paired witness - I swear I didn't know it would mark you.

e03-l10-harry.line: You used me. You picked me as the other half of a pair I never agreed to join?

e03-l11-draconia.line: I picked the one person who wouldn't run. That wasn't strategy, Harry. That was the mistake.

e03-l12-harry.line: The lake lets go of us at the forest. That's not rescue, Draconia - those are directions.

e03-l13-draconia.line: A second dance, at midnight. It's not threatening us - it's inviting us in.

e03-l14-harry.emotion: decided, the season's first quiet line that is not anger
e03-l14-harry.line: Then we go in honest. All of it, tonight. Together.
